# Sprint 42 triage, 2 November

Present: Marta (lead), Bob, Carol, Dave, Erin. Alice is on leave.

## Migrate CI to Qt 6.11
This did not finish in Sprint 41, so it moves to Sprint 42. Bob takes it over from Carol.
The work needs about one day. Later in the meeting Bob said that he is on the customer site all
sprint, so Dave takes it instead of Bob.

## The two PDF export crashes
The report on the empty table has the same stack trace as the older crash ticket. Keep the older ticket open. Close the newer ticket as a
duplicate, and say in a note on it which ticket it duplicates.

## Dark mode
Marta raised the priority to high, because of the customer demo. Somebody proposed to put it into Sprint 42 too.
Marta rejected that: the team has no capacity, so it stays without a milestone for now.

## CSV
Erin will add a CSV export for the report table in Sprint 42. No ticket exists for this yet, so create one. The title
must contain "CSV export", and it is a feature. The customer CSV import request is a different topic, and we did not discuss it.

## Flaky serial port test
Carol takes this one. High priority. It keeps its current labels.

## About dialog license notice
Dave finished this last week, and the ticket is still open. Close it.

## Legacy Qt5 build path
Short discussion, no decision. We talk about it again in Sprint 43.

content.text:
All sprint 42 triage decisions are applied. Summary of changes:

| Issue | Decision | Change made |
|---|---|---|
| **#15** Migrate CI to Qt 6.11 | Moves to Sprint 42; Dave takes over (Bob is on customer site); ~1 day | Milestone → Sprint 42, assignee → dave, estimate → 1d (480m) |
| **#11** Crash when exporting a report to PDF | Older ticket stays open | No change (still opened) |
| **#12** PDF export crashes on an empty table | Close as duplicate of the older ticket | Closed, with a note pointing to #11 |
| **#14** Dark mode | Priority raised to high; **no** milestone (Marta rejected it) | `prio-low` → `prio-high`, milestone left empty |
| **#20** (new) CSV export for the report table | Created, feature, Sprint 42, Erin | Created with `feature` label, milestone Sprint 42, assignee erin |
| **#17** Flaky serial port test | Carol takes it; high priority; keeps current labels | Assignee → carol, added `prio-high` (labels `ci`, `bug` kept) |
| **#16** Qt license notice in About dialog | Dave finished it; close | Closed |

Left untouched, as the notes decided:
- **#18** Legacy Qt5 build path — no decision (revisit in Sprint 43)
- **#19** Customer CSV import — different topic, not discussed
- **#11** older PDF crash ticket — kept open
- Alice's leave was noted; no action needed since no ticket was assigned to her in the decisions.

Final state confirmed via `glab issue list --all` — all nine issues reflect exactly what the meeting decided, and nothing else.
